name: BookPageCurl
src_typeComment: Plug-and-play book controller: works for BOTH a UI book (PageCurlGraphic + RawImageTextureDisplay) and a 3D world-space book (PageCurlMeshRenderer + MeshRendererTextureDisplay) unchanged, since it only ever talks to its surfaces through ICurlSurface/ITextureDisplay. Setup: assign a page list, a left/right static backing surface (shows the flat, non-turning spread), ONE curling overlay surface reused for both directions, and a hingeAnchor Transform marking the book's spine position/rotation.  currentPageIndex always refers to the page currently shown on the RIGHT; the left page is currentPageIndex - 1. Turning forward moves the right page to become the new left page (revealing the next page on the right); turning backward is the mirror image.

src_serialized.name: pages
src_serialized.tooltip: Pages in order. currentPageIndex starts pointing at pages[0] as the initial right page.

src_serialized.name: leftBackingBehaviour
src_serialized.tooltip: Shows the static left page of the current spread. Must implement ITextureDisplay (RawImageTextureDisplay for UI, MeshRendererTextureDisplay for 3D).

src_serialized.name: rightBackingBehaviour
src_serialized.tooltip: Shows the static right page of the current spread. Must implement ITextureDisplay.

src_serialized.name: curlSurfaceBehaviour
src_serialized.tooltip: The ONE animated curling page, reused for both forward and backward turns. Must implement ICurlSurface (PageCurlGraphic for UI, PageCurlMeshRenderer for 3D).

src_serialized.name: hingeAnchor
src_serialized.tooltip: Marks the book's spine position/rotation. The curl surface is moved here and mirrored (localScale.x flipped) at the start of every turn.

src_serialized.name: flipDuration
src_serialized.tooltip: How long an auto-animated (button-driven) turn takes, in seconds.

src_serialized.name: dragCommitThreshold
src_serialized.tooltip: Fraction of the page (0-1) that must be dragged before releasing commits the turn instead of springing back.
